title: Beautiful Pillers
statement: An array of n ≤ 2·10^5 values must be made beautiful, every index inside an equal-valued pair with only smaller values between, in the fewest assignments. Setting both ends to the maximum always works, so the answer is 0, 1 or 2. The maximum must repeat and the parts outside its first and last occurrences must be beautiful alone, so three candidate changes each need one O(n) monotonic-stack check.
